comment: Retrieval and integrity manifest. Document METADATA (titles, report numbers, dates, authors, evidence status) lives in resources/PRIMARY_SOURCE_CATALOG.md and resources/source-catalog/*.md, which remain the provenance authority. This file records only what is needed to fetch a document and prove the bytes have not changed. Seeded from the Apollo 13 PC+2 dependency set plus the structural sources the baseline documents rest on; extend as later scenarios require documents. See docs/SOURCE_MIRRORING.md for the tiering rule.

documents.title: Mission Operations Report - Apollo 13 (controller appendices A-N)
documents.note: Most-cited document in the repository. The three URLs are cited across seven files; confirm on fetch whether they are the same document. NASA's 'Post Launch Mission Operations Report' is a distinct publication and is not this document.

documents.title: Report of Apollo 13 Review Board, Appendix A - Baseline Data
documents.note: Part A4 is the MOCR/SSR organisational basis for notes 003 and 004. Also the source of the unresolved 'LM/TELCOM' nomenclature conflict.

documents.title: Report of Apollo 13 Review Board, Appendices B-E
documents.note: Figures B7-7/B7-8/B7-9 are the EECOM console and display evidence. Needed to verify the panel-3 limit-light counts, the 30-second limit-sense finding, and the OCR'd parameter codes in stations/APOLLO13_EECOM.md.

documents.title: AS-508 MCC/MSFN Mission Configuration / System Description
documents.note: Source for the HSD Format 30 characteristics and the Apollo 13-era ground-system baseline.

documents.title: MSC Apollo 13 Investigation Team, Panel 3 - Flight Operations and Network, Final Report
documents.note: Parent report containing the Mission Operations Report. NTRS 19710010485.

documents.title: Analysis of Apollo 13 LM systems during emergency operation (Panel 3 Addendum 1)
Apollo 13 Mission Report
documents.note: MSC-02680. Cited by stations/APOLLO13_TELMU.md sections 7.2.3-7.2.5 but absent from the main source catalog as of the 2026-09-12 audit.

documents.title: R-567 Section 2 Rev 8 - LUMINARY 1C Data Links (GSOP)
documents.note: Apollo 13's flown LM AGC program. Needed to settle the P21/P27 program-number error in stations/APOLLO13_GUIDO.md and note 016.

documents.title: Apollo 13 Simulation Discrepancy Reports
documents.note: Filename misspelling is upstream; preserved so the URL resolves.

documents.title: LM-7/8/9 Elementary Functional Diagrams
documents.note: LM-7 is the Apollo 13 vehicle. Source for the GQ-series telemetry measurement identifiers used by the PC+2 rule paths.

documents.title: Apollo 13 PAO Mission Commentary Transcript
Apollo 11 Flight Mission Rules, AS-506/CSM-107/LM-5
documents.note: Two casings are cited in the repository; one is likely wrong. Resolve on fetch.

documents.title: Apollo 10 LM-4 DPS Final Flight Evaluation (TRW)
documents.note: Cross-mission DPS behaviour used by the PC+2 throttle/ullage work.

documents.title: Sundance Functional Description, Volume 1
Apollo Experience Report - Real-Time Display System (TN D-8316)
Apollo Experience Report - Flight-Control Data Needs and Terminal Display Devices (TN D-7685)
documents.note: Source of the 28-to-36 computer-driven TV channel claim and the display-request vs channel-attach distinction in CONTROLLER_INFORMATION_WORKFLOW.md, which the 2026-09-12 audit found asserted from a catalog entry still marked IDENTIFIED.

documents.title: What Made Apollo a Success? (NASA SP-287)
Apollo Mission Control, HAER TX-109-C
documents.note: Needed to verify the 1044.9 display-requests-per-hour figure and the PHO-TN401 footnote. Cited by three documents but absent from the main source catalog as of the 2026-09-12 audit.

documents.title: MSC Flight Crew Operations Branch - Simulator Operations (McCafferty, 1968)
The Early Days of Simulation and Operations (Harold G. Miller)
documents.note: Needed to settle whether the Honeycutt recollection and the pre-Apollo-11 program-alarm simulation are the same run.

documents.title: Telemetry and Communications to Apollo Flight Controllers (Glines and Lazzaro, ITC 1970)
documents.note: Conference proceedings, not a NASA publication; rights unverified. Cited in the repository as 'R. W. Winkelman et al., Telemetry and Communications to Apollo', which the 2026-09-12 audit found to be the wrong author and a truncated title. Reclassify to link-only if the repository's terms are restrictive.

documents.title: AC Electronics - Apollo 13 Guidance & Navigation Summary
documents.pages: ASPO 45 CRT Displays section - the MSK 683/966/1123/1137 display definitions
documents.note: 244 MB scan; whole-document mirroring is not viable and is not needed. The index URL is a landing page, so the direct scan URL must be recorded here before fetch can work. The project reports this section has now been inspected directly; extracting the pages makes that inspection reviewable.

documents.title: LMA790-3-LM10 Apollo Operations Handbook, LM-10 and subsequent, Vol 1 - Subsystems Data
documents.pages: DPS and RCS subsystem sections supporting the PC+2 inlet-pressure, chamber-pressure and STOP-pushbutton evidence
documents.note: Cited in the repository under both ibiblio.org and www.ibiblio.org. LM-10 is a later vehicle than Apollo 13's LM-7; the chronology caveat in the station specs must survive extraction.

documents.title: Familiarization Manual - Mission Control Center Houston (PHO-FAM001, 1967)
documents.pages: Voice Communications Subsystem section and keyset illustrations
documents.note: Primary technical source for note 009 and VOICE_COMMUNICATIONS_BASELINE.md, but absent from the main source catalog as of the 2026-09-12 audit.

documents.title: Smithsonian NASM.1986.0158 - Apollo Flight Guidance Computer Software Collection (Hamilton)
documents.note: Archival finding aid, not a document. Corroborates the existence of the Apollo 13 G&N Summary; no claim should rest on it alone.

documents.title: Universal CSM Console Handbook section D5 - Real-Time Commanding (transcription)
documents.note: Third-party transcription used as a discovery aid. The original May 1969 handbook has not been located.

documents.title: PHO-TR155 MCC Operational Configuration, Apollo 15 (1971-03-26)
documents.note: Adjacent-mission edition of the document the project lists as a very high priority target (H-2 Revision C, 1970-03-06, existence confirmed via PHO-TR474). Lead surfaced 2026-09-12 but not yet opened; promote to full once retrieved and its rights basis is established. Values must not be carried across missions.
